title: Nucleoid
description: Open-source minigames - by and for the community!
body:
# Nucleoid

Nucleoid is developing open-source minigames within the Fabric ecosystem on modern versions of Minecraft! This means that all of our minigames are developed by and for the community: anyone can contribute, and anyone can use or expand on what we have created!

## Play
We have a very wide range of minigames available on our server, created by our wonderful community - ranging from classics such as Bed Wars, Quakecraft, or Sky Wars - to unique minigames such as Shard Thief, Creeperfall, or our favorite - _Explosive Tater Spleef_ (need we say more?).

## Get Involved

For all kinds of coordination of development and playing together, consider joining our Discord server! Whether you have feedback on a minigame, would like to build a new map, or create a new minigame from scratch - we'd love to work with you! You might also consider checking out our [GitHub](https://github.com/NucleoidMC) and [Documentation](https://docs.nucleoid.xyz/). 

If you would like to set up your own server with our minigames, you may download compiled builds of the minigames of your choosing from the relevant GitHub repositories.
